confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Koh Samui tourist pricing; no live menus, booking pages or listings were checked. Remembered baht prices were brought forward to July 2026 and translated at an assumed rate near 33 THB per USD, so the USD anchors carry exchange-rate uncertainty. Restaurant anchors are the firmest; hostel and hotel rates are seasonal and less certain. Cocktail and wine anchors were set relative to the beer anchor (about two to two-and-a-half times beer, typical of Thai tourist venues) because direct knowledge of venue drink prices is weaker. The 2026-10-15 RBA rate comes from web search results citing the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not open that page or the F11.1 table, so confirm it against the live RBA table before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single named comparable city was used. The basis is a model-based comparison with other Thai island beach destinations such as Phuket and Krabi and with Thai tourist-town price levels, adjusted to Koh Samui's July 2026 conditions.
